items.title: REST APIs built for production use.
items.description: Owned five production REST APIs and contributed to more than 40. Built and maintained request validation, authentication, PostgreSQL data access, integrations and production support.

items.title: An agent that can use tools with permission.
items.description: Built a Node.js agentic AI system end to end. It supports tool calling, planning, multi-step execution, subagents, conversation state, structured outputs, streaming and human approval for changes. Added role-based authorization and audit logging. Built a provider-agnostic service for OpenAI, Gemini and Groq, with fallback, retries and rate-limit handling. Caching and API/LLM tuning cut typical runs from 30 - 60 seconds to 6 - 18 seconds.

items.title: Async workflows built to handle failures.
items.description: Used Redis, Bull, AWS SQS, Lambda and API Gateway for asynchronous processing, retries, caching and TTL-based work. Debugged production failures with CloudWatch and application logs. Improved an HTML personalization pipeline for 10K - 35K character pages from 30 - 50 seconds to 6 - 12 seconds.

sections.label: AFTER HOURS
sections.heading: A job scheduler I built from scratch.
sections.lead: A separate project for learning how distributed jobs behave.
sections.description: It uses Redis for queueing and PostgreSQL for job state. It supports scheduled execution, concurrent workers, retries, idempotency and failure recovery.
